fonte: PES = A Systematic Survey of Prompt Engineering in Large Language Models: Techniques and Applications (Sahoo et al.), arXiv:2402.07927v2, 16 Mar 2025
datado: [DATED] Mar/2025; numbers 'as reported' in the survey, from different models/datasets; not comparable across techniques.

tecnicas.name: Zero-shot
tecnicas.summary: Only the task description, no labeled examples; uses the knowledge already in the model.
tecnicas.limits: No examples: depends on what the model already knows (inference from the definition, p.2).

tecnicas.name: Few-shot
tecnicas.summary: A few high-quality input-output pairs in the prompt to induce the task.
reported: Improves complex tasks compared with no demonstrations (p.2).
tecnicas.limits: Spends tokens; the selection and composition of the examples influence behavior; biases such as favoring frequent words persist (p.2).

tecnicas.name: Chain-of-Thought (CoT)
tecnicas.summary: Demonstrations showing step-by-step reasoning and the final answer on multi-step problems.
reported: PaLM 540B: 90.2% accuracy, state of the art on math and commonsense according to the survey (p.2).
tecnicas.limits: Requires well-made reasoning examples (writing them by hand is time-consuming, p.2).

tecnicas.name: Automatic Chain-of-Thought (Auto-CoT)
tecnicas.summary: Generates the reasoning chains with 'Let's think step by step' and samples diverse questions to build demonstrations.
reported: +1.33% (arithmetic) and +1.5% (symbolic) over CoT with GPT-3 (p.2).
tecnicas.limits: Individual chains may contain errors; sampling diversity mitigates this (p.2).

tecnicas.name: Self-Consistency
tecnicas.summary: Samples several reasoning chains and picks the most consistent answer (marginalizes) instead of greedy decoding.
reported: Over CoT: +17.9% GSM8K, +11.0% SVAMP, +12.2% AQuA, +6.4% StrategyQA, +3.9% ARC-challenge (p.2).
tecnicas.limits: Cost of multiple decoding samples (inference from the description, p.2).

tecnicas.name: Logical Chain-of-Thought (LogiCoT)
tecnicas.summary: Neuro-symbolic framework: applies reductio ad absurdum to verify each step and revise wrong steps (think-verify-revise).
reported: Vicuna-33b/GPT-4: +0.16%/+1.42% on GSM8K and +3.15%/+2.75% on AQuA over CoT (p.4).

tecnicas.name: Chain-of-Symbol (CoS)
tecnicas.summary: Condensed symbols instead of natural language for spatial reasoning.
reported: ChatGPT: 31.8%→92.6% on Brick World; up to 65.8% fewer prompt tokens (p.4).
tecnicas.limits: Scalability, generalization, integration with other techniques and interpretability of reasoning with symbols (p.4).

tecnicas.name: Tree-of-Thoughts (ToT)
tecnicas.summary: Tree of intermediate thoughts; the model generates and evaluates thoughts and uses search (BFS/DFS) with lookahead and backtracking.
reported: Game of 24: 74% vs 4% for CoT; word task: 60% vs 16% (p.4).
tecnicas.limits: Multiple calls and search (inference from the description, p.4).

tecnicas.name: Graph-of-Thoughts (GoT)
tecnicas.summary: Thoughts as a directed graph, with aggregation and combination of branches, backtracking and evaluation.
reported: T5-base +3.41% and T5-large +5.08% on GSM8K; ScienceQA +6.63% (base) and +1.09% (large) over Multimodal-CoT (p.4).

tecnicas.name: System 2 Attention (S2A)
tecnicas.summary: The LLM regenerates the context keeping only the relevant part and then answers with the refined context.
reported: Factual QA: 80.3% accuracy; long-form generation: 3.82/5 in objectivity (p.4).

tecnicas.name: Thread of Thought (ThoT)
tecnicas.summary: Splits chaotic contexts into segments, summarizes and examines each one and only then refines the answer; plug-and-play module.
reported: +47.20% on QA and +17.8% on conversation, especially in chaotic contexts (p.4).

tecnicas.name: Chain of Table
tecnicas.summary: Step-by-step tabular reasoning that generates and executes SQL/DataFrame operations on the table.
reported: +8.69% on TabFact and +6.72% on WikiTQ (p.4).
tecnicas.limits: Requires executing operations on the table (p.4).

tecnicas.name: Self-Refine
tecnicas.datasets: 7 diverse tasks (e.g., dialogue response, mathematical reasoning)
tecnicas.summary: Generates an answer, the model critiques its own output and refines it; repeats until a stopping criterion.
reported: GPT-4: +8.7 pts in code optimization, +13.9 in readability, +21.6 in sentiment reversal (p.5).
tecnicas.limits: Several calls; depends on stopping criteria (p.5).

tecnicas.name: Code Prompting
tecnicas.summary: Reformulates natural-language problems as structured code for text+code LLMs, without executing it.
reported: GPT-3.5 +8.42 average F1; Mistral +4.22 on three datasets (p.5).

tecnicas.name: Self-Harmonized CoT (ECHO)
tecnicas.summary: Clusters questions (Sentence-BERT + k-means), samples demonstrations with Zero-Shot-CoT and iteratively unifies the rationales.
reported: +2.8% over Auto-CoT on 10 benchmarks; with 50% fewer examples, a drop of -0.8% (Few-Shot-CoT: -1.3%); +2.3% on Mixtral-8x7B (p.5).
tecnicas.limits: Behind GPT-3.5 on Mixtral because of rationale quality (p.5).

tecnicas.name: Logic-of-Thought (LoT)
tecnicas.summary: Extracts propositions, extends them with logical laws (Python module) and translates back into the prompt to reduce unfaithful reasoning.
reported: +4.35% (ReClor, with CoT), +5% (LogiQA, CoT+SC), +8% (ProofWriter, with ToT) (p.5).

tecnicas.name: Instance-adaptive Prompting (IAP)
tecnicas.summary: Chooses the zero-shot-CoT prompt per instance using attention saliency (IAP-ss and IAP-mv).
reported: IAP-mv: +1.82% on LLaMA-3-8B and +3.31% on Qwen-14B on GSM8K/SVAMP (p.5).

tecnicas.name: End-to-End DAG-Path (EEDP)
tecnicas.summary: Represents graphs by prioritizing paths between extremes (DAG via BFS), preserving adjacency lists and compressing shared segments.
reported: -55% tokens on molecular graphs; EPCP +10.21%/+16.76% and EPDP +4.73%/+30.13% (p.6).

tecnicas.name: Layer-of-Thoughts (LoT)
tecnicas.summary: Filtering layers (keywords, semantics, confirmation) with hard and soft constraints for legal retrieval.
reported: F2 0.835 (precision 0.838, recall 0.839) on Japanese Civil Law vs 0.807; recall 0.966 on German traffic law (p.6).

tecnicas.name: Narrative-of-Thought (NoT)
tecnicas.summary: Temporally anchored narratives and a Python class to build temporal graphs; demonstrations generated by GPT-4.
reported: LLaMA3-8B: F1 42.2 vs GPT-3.5 45.7; models <10B are ~50% behind GPT-3.5/4 on the TGG benchmark without the technique (p.6).
tecnicas.limits: Even GPT-4 struggles because of alignment constraints (p.6).

tecnicas.name: Buffer of Thoughts (BoT)
tecnicas.datasets: 10 reasoning tasks (e.g., Game of 24, Geometric Shapes)
tecnicas.summary: Meta-buffer of reusable 'thought-templates' and a manager that refines them as new problems arrive.
reported: +11% Game of 24, +20% Geometric Shapes, +51% Checkmate-in-One; 12% of the cost of multi-query methods such as ToT; Llama3-8B+BoT outperforms Llama3-70B (p.6).

tecnicas.name: Contrastive Denoising with Noisy CoT (CD-CoT)
tecnicas.summary: Contrasts noisy rationales with clean ones, rephrases failed examples, chooses paths and votes on the most consistent answer.
reported: +17.8% accuracy on average (p.6).
tecnicas.limits: Models copy incorrect reasoning from noisy examples; self-correction fails without external feedback and self-consistency does not fix reasoning failures (p.6).

tecnicas.name: Reverse Chain-of-Thought (R-CoT)
tecnicas.summary: Two-stage pipeline (GeoChain and Reverse A&Q) that generates geometric data with detailed chains for multimodal models.
reported: An 8B model outperforms GPT-4o by 12.5% (MathVista) and 14.5% (GeoQA) (p.7).

tecnicas.name: Chain of Draft (CoD)
tecnicas.summary: Reasoning with short, information-dense steps instead of verbose chains.
reported: Matches or beats CoT; in some cases -80% output tokens; average latency -76.2% (p.7).

tecnicas.name: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
tecnicas.summary: Retrieves passages from a pre-built knowledge base and inserts them into the prompt before generation.
reported: Outperforms seq2seq and task-specific architectures on ODQA: EM up to 56.8% (TriviaQA) and 44.5% (Natural Questions) (p.7).
tecnicas.limits: Depends on a knowledge base and on retrieval (p.7).

tecnicas.name: ReAct
tecnicas.summary: Interleaved reasoning traces and task-specific actions; updates plans and handles exceptions by interacting with an API.
reported: ALFWorld 34% and WebShop 10% success with few examples; HotpotQA and Fever with the Wikipedia API (p.7).

tecnicas.name: Chain-of-Verification (CoVe)
tecnicas.summary: Four steps: baseline answer, plan verification questions, answer them independently and produce a revised answer.
reported: Reduces hallucinations in lists, QA and long-form generation while keeping the facts (p.7).

tecnicas.name: Chain-of-Note (CoN)
tecnicas.summary: Assesses the relevance of each retrieved document and filters noise, answering 'unknown' when information is missing.
reported: +7.9 average EM with noisy documents and +10.5 in rejection rate for questions outside the knowledge (p.7).

tecnicas.name: Chain-of-Knowledge (CoK)
tecnicas.datasets: HotpotQA, FEVER, MedMCQA, MMLU Physics and Biology
tecnicas.summary: Reasoning preparation and dynamic knowledge adaptation from internal sources, external bases and the prompt.
reported: The text gives no gain figures (p.7-8).
tecnicas.limits: The survey describes only the two phases; no numerical results in the text (p.8).

tecnicas.name: Active-Prompt
tecnicas.summary: Selects by uncertainty (inspired by active learning) the most useful questions for annotating CoT examples.
reported: Outperforms self-consistency by 7.0% on average (text-davinci-002) and 1.8% (code-davinci-002) on eight tasks (p.8).
tecnicas.limits: Requires human annotation of the chosen examples (inference from the description, p.8).

tecnicas.name: Automatic Prompt Engineer (APE)
tecnicas.metrics: Execution accuracy, Log probability, Efficient score estimation
tecnicas.summary: Generates and selects instructions automatically (candidates generated by the LLM and choice of the best).
reported: Outperforms human prompts on 19 of 24 BIG-Bench tasks (p.8).

tecnicas.name: Automatic Reasoning and Tool-use (ART)
tecnicas.summary: Multi-step reasoning through structured programs with pauses to use external tools.
reported: Outperforms traditional prompting on BigBench/MMLU and in some cases matches handwritten demonstrations (p.8).

tecnicas.name: Contrastive Chain-of-Thought (CCoT)
tecnicas.summary: Shows valid and invalid reasoning demonstrations so the model learns from mistakes.
reported: 4-16% improvement on strategic and mathematical reasoning vs CoT; ~+5% with self-consistency (p.8).
tecnicas.limits: Open problem: generating contrasts automatically for diverse problems and applying them beyond reasoning (p.8).

tecnicas.name: Emotion Prompting (EmotionPrompt)
tecnicas.summary: Appends 11 emotional-stimulus phrases to the prompt.
reported: +8.00% relative on instruction induction; +115% on BIG-Bench tasks; study with 106 participants: +10.9% in performance, truthfulness and responsibility (p.8).

tecnicas.name: Scratchpad Prompting
tecnicas.summary: The model generates an arbitrary sequence of intermediate tokens before the final answer.
reported: 46.8% on MBPP-aug; combining CodeNet and single-line: 26.6% correct final outputs and 24.6% perfect traces (p.9).
tecnicas.limits: Fixed window of 512 tokens and dependence on supervised learning to use the scratchpad (p.9).

tecnicas.name: Program of Thoughts (PoT)
tecnicas.summary: Expresses reasoning as Python programs run by an external interpreter.
reported: ~12% average gain over CoT on math and financial problems (p.9).

tecnicas.name: Structured Chain-of-Thought (SCoT)
tecnicas.summary: Incorporates program structures (sequence, branch, loop) into the reasoning steps for code generation.
reported: Up to +13.79% over CoT on HumanEval, MBPP and MBCPP (p.9).

tecnicas.name: Chain-of-Code (CoC)
tecnicas.summary: Formats semantic subtasks as flexible pseudocode; the interpreter catches undefined behavior and an 'LMulator' simulates it.
reported: 84% accuracy on BIG-Bench Hard (+12%) (p.9).

tecnicas.name: Optimization by Prompting (OPRO)
tecnicas.summary: Uses LLMs as optimizers: iteratively generates solutions (or prompts) from natural-language descriptions.
reported: Optimized prompts outperform human ones by up to 8% (GSM8K) and up to 50% (Big-Bench) (p.9).

tecnicas.name: Rephrase and Respond (RaR)
tecnicas.metrics: Accuracy, Fair Score, Language Modeling Score
tecnicas.summary: The LLM rephrases and expands the question; a two-step variant uses one LLM to rephrase and another to answer.
reported: Improves understanding and accuracy by resolving ambiguities in the question (p.9, no numbers in the text).

tecnicas.name: Take a Step Back Prompting
tecnicas.summary: Two steps: abstraction (extract general concepts and principles) and reasoning.
reported: PaLM-2L: +7% on MMLU Physics and Chemistry, +27% on TimeQA, +7% on MuSiQue (p.9).
